answer: A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the delta queue naming the walnut that holds the sponsor's bond. Therefore, each duplicate self costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the atlas record reveals exactly who is still on probation. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
